The proprietary technology platform aims to simplify the demands of the complex world of global travel by seamlessly connecting the highly distributed travel buyers and travel suppliers at scale.

name: SHYAMOLI (Shyamoli Paribahan Private Limited)
d:
Shyamoli Paribahan Private Limited moves more than 1.4 million
passengers a year across ten plus  Indian states, on a fleet of Volvo
and Scania multi-axle coaches. We have been doing it since 2004.

The company began with a single bus on the Kolkata–Asansol route,
run by our founder Arun Kumar Ghosh. Two decades on, the network
runs down the eastern corridor and into the south — West Bengal,
Odisha, Jharkhand, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Tamil
Nadu and Kerala.

WHERE WE ARE TAKING THIS
Indian intercity road transport is consolidating around three
things: owned fleet quality, direct digital demand, and operating
data. We are investing in all three. We run our own coaches rather
than subcontracting them. We are building our own booking channel
— shyamolibus.com, our app and our call centre — instead of
renting demand from aggregators alone. And we are putting every
service under GPS and CCTV into a single operations view, so route
decisions come from data rather than habit.

The network was built east and south. The next phase is west and
north.

HOW WE OPERATE
- 190+ scheduled departures a day
- 150+ owned coaches — Volvo and Scania multi-axle, AC sleeper and
  seater
- GPS tracking and CCTV on every service
- Multiple boarding points on every corridor we serve

WHO WE WORK WITH
OEM and coach-building partners, state terminal and transport
authorities, ticketing and CRM technology providers, online travel
platforms, and corporates running recurring intercity movements.

CAREERS
We hire drivers and crew, workshop technicians, depot supervisors,
booking and counter staff, and digital, marketing and technology
roles across the ten-state network. Openings are posted here.

Shyamoli Paribahan Private Limited is an Indian company,
incorporated in 2004 and headquartered in Kolkata. We are not
affiliated with any similarly named operator in or outside India.

Our story dates to 1973, when founder Graham Turner (aka “Skroo") and friend Geoff “Spy” Lomas buy a double-decker bus and take off on their first tour around Spain, Portugal and Morrocco, 3 years later forming the first business, Top Deck. After flight deregulations in the 80s our first retail "Flight Centre" stores opened in Australia in 1982, London in 1984, and NZ in 1987. 

1987 was also the year we held our first “Global Gathering” awards event celebrating our amazing people, a tradition that continues to this day. 

And in 2025 we launched our very first loyalty program, World360 Rewards! Our Australian customers now able to earn and redeem points across Flight Centre, Travel Associates, and Cruiseabout.

We’re in our 40s now and a lot has changed! With global headquarters in Brisbane, Australia, our company owned leisure and corporate travel businesses span three major regions: APAC, The Americas and EMEA. 

Our flagship corporate travel management brand, FCM, extends our reach even further through a network covering over 100 countries via both company-owned operations and independent licensees. 

With 30 brands across our global footprint, our team spans from customer-facing to internal support roles. The opportunities just as diverse – from a Travel Consultant at Flight Centre or Envoyage, to a Machine Learning Scientist in one of our tech pillars. 

Together, we live and breathe our number one philosophy, Our People, driven by our purpose ‘To open up the world for those who want to see’.  

Our values are simple and powerful - Ownership, Egalitarianism and Irreverence.  

We support our people with opportunities to help you thrive, connect, give, move and be rewarded. Our people have access to a suite of curated benefits to ensure holistic wellbeing – from mental and physical health to financial freedom.

name: Scrapbuddy
d:
SCRAPBUDDY is an innovative tech platform that aims to improve the traditional unorganized kabadiwala system.

Here's a bitter fact:

"India generates 62 million tonnes of municipal solid waste (MSW) annually. Out of the 43 million tonnes of MSW collected, about 31 million tonnes end up in landfills while only 12 million tonnes undergo treatment."

But why does almost 75% of collected waste end up in landfills?

The answer is simple — We're failing to segregate waste at ground level.

But the story doesn't end here. According to Bloomberg, Indian landfills comprise 60% organic waste. This organic waste, in landfills, undergoes anaerobic reaction and produces Methane gas (CH4), which is the second largest Greenhouse Gas and 25 times more potent than Carbon dioxide (CO2). On March 22, 2022, the Ghazipur dump leaked an estimated 2.17 metric tonnes of methane in an hour.

Scary, isn't it?

To fight this mounting garbage problem, you need a capable buddy. And that's where we come into picture.

SCRAPBUDDY aims to eradicate this problem by promoting the segregation of waste at source. We do this by organizing the traditional kabadiwala system with our tech capabilities, and rewarding our customers with cash for their trash. This way we not only minimize the GHG emissions, but also contribute to the circular economy by recycling the waste collected.

So join us in our fight against this mounting garbage problem. Follow our official channels!
